verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated sandbox environment, separate from production, with its own frontend (demo.ramp.com) and API base (demo-api.ramp.com). It blocks real money movement, offers simulation hooks for events, and is wired into the agent tooling: the CLI connects to the sandbox by default and there is a demo MCP endpoint. This is true environment isolation, not a dry-run mode. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (no probe of the sandbox endpoints).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The Ramp sandbox is a testing environment where developers and partners can safely build, test, and experiment with Ramp's API without affecting live production data.
No real money movement: Demo accounts cannot process actual financial transactions.
By default, the CLI connects to the Sandbox environment
